blocks.text: Ba'zan biz haqiqatda **yo'q** narsa haqida xayol qilamiz: «Mashinam **bo'lganida** (lekin yo'q), ishga mashinada **borardim**». Ingliz tilida bu **if** + **Past Simple**, ... **would** + fe'l bilan aytiladi: If I **had** a car, I **would drive** to work. Diqqat: fe'l o'tgan zamon shaklida (**had**), lekin ma'no **hozirgi** yoki **kelajak**! Bu yerda o'tgan zamon vaqtni emas, «haqiqatdan uzoqlikni» bildiradi. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «`-sa edi`», «`-ganida`», «`-ardim`» shakllarida o'tgan zamon belgisi bor, lekin gap hozirgi holat haqida.
Tuzilish: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l

**would** barcha shaxslar bilan bir xil: I / you / he / we / they **would**. Qisqa shakli — **'d**: I**'d**, she**'d**, we**'d**; inkori — **wouldn't**. **would** dan keyin fe'l `to` siz, birinchi shaklda keladi: would **go**, would **buy**. **if** li qismda esa — Past Simple: had, knew, lived, could, **didn't** have, **wasn't**. Tartib real shartdagidek erkin: If I had time, I'd help you. = I'd help you if I had time.

rows: we**'d see** Big Ben every day.

items.text: **If** I **had** more free time, I**'d learn** to play the piano.
My brother **would buy** a house **if** houses **weren't** so expensive.
items.translation: Uylar bunchalik **qimmat bo'lmaganida**, akam uy **sotib olardi**.

blocks.text: 99-darsdagi real shart — **mumkin bo'lgan** narsa: If I **have** time tomorrow, I**'ll help** you (balki vaqtim bo'lar). Xayoliy shart — **haqiqatga zid** yoki deyarli mumkin bo'lmagan narsa: If I **had** time, I**'d help** you (lekin vaqtim yo'q). O'zbekchada farq shunday: «Vaqtim **bo'lsa**, yordam **beraman**» ↔ «Vaqtim **bo'lganida**, yordam **berardim**». Ba'zan farqni so'zlovchining o'zi tanlaydi: If I **win** the match ... (yutishim mumkin deb o'ylayman) ↔ If I **won** the lottery ... (bu deyarli imkonsiz).

rows: If it **is** sunny tomorrow, we**'ll go** to the beach.
If it **was** sunny today, we**'d go** to the beach.

items.text: **If** I **find** your keys, I**'ll give** them to you.
**If** I **knew** where your keys were, I**'d tell** you.

blocks.text: Xayoliy shartda **be** fe'li ko'pincha barcha shaxslar bilan **were** shaklida keladi: If I **were** rich, if she **were** here, if it **were** warmer. So'zlashuvda I / he / she / it bilan **was** ham ishlatiladi (If I **was** rich) — bu ham to'g'ri, lekin **were** ni eslab qoling. Eng mashhur ibora — **If I were you**, I'd ... — maslahat berishning yumshoq usuli. O'zbekchada: «**O'rningda bo'lsam** (bo'lganimda), ...».

items.text: **If I were you**, I**'d call** her and say sorry.
I **wouldn't eat** that fish **if I were you** — it smells strange.
items.translation: **O'rningda bo'lsam**, u baliqni **yemasdim** — g'alati hid kelyapti.

items.text: **If** Bekzod **were** here, he**'d know** what to do.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «If I **would have** money, ...» → If I **had** money, ... (**would** faqat natija qismida, **if** li qismda hech qachon); «If I **have** money, I **would** buy ...» → zamonlarni aralashtirmang: **have** → **will**, **had** → **would**; «If I **am** you ...» → **If I were you** ...; «I would **bought**» → I would **buy** (would dan keyin fe'lning birinchi shakli).

Natija qismida **would** o'rniga **could** («... qila olardim») yoki **might** («balki ... `-ardim`») ham keladi. Ma'no farqi: **would** — aniq natija, **could** — imkoniyat paydo bo'lardi, **might** — natija ehtimoli bor, lekin aniq emas.

rows: If I spoke French, I **would** move to Paris.
If I spoke French, I **could** work in Paris.
If I spoke French, I **might** find a job in Paris.

blocks.text: Savol: What would you do if ...?

Xayoliy savol — suhbatning sevimli mavzusi: What **would** you **do** if you **won** a lot of money? Javob ham **would** bilan: I**'d travel** around the world. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I **would**. / No, I **wouldn't**. O'zbekchada: «... yutib olsang, nima qilarding? — Dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim».

items.text: **Would** you **live** abroad **if** you **could**? — Yes, I would.
Where **would** you **go** **if** you **had** a free week?

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: **if** + o'tgan zamon (had, knew, were) → **would** + fe'l. «`-ganida` / `-sa edi` ... `-ardim`» ni ko'rsangiz — xayoliy shart. **would** faqat natija qismida turadi.

Bog'lanish: real shart (If I **have** ..., I **will** ...) → 99-dars; **would like** → 34-dars; **could** → 30-dars; **might** → 29-dars. **'d** ham **would**, ham **had** bo'lishi mumkin → 119-dars (qisqa shakllar).

rows: If I **had** a garden, I**'d grow** vegetables.
If it **wasn't** so far, we **wouldn't take** a taxi.
If I **had** a car, I **could** drive you.

examples.title: **If** + past, ... **would** ...: imagining
examples.description: Xayoliy shart — haqiqatda yo'q narsa haqida. **if** li qismda Past Simple (lekin ma'no — hozir!), natijada **would** / **'d**. O'zbekchada — «`-ganida` / `-sa edi` ... `-ardim`».

sentences.text: **If** I **had** a car, I**'d drive** to work.
We**'d swim** every day **if** we **lived** near the sea.
Aziz **would buy** a new phone **if** it **wasn't** so expensive.
**If** Dilnoza **knew** the answer, she**'d tell** us.
My grandfather **would be** ninety **if** he **were** still alive.
Life **would be** much easier **if** I **didn't have** to work on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari ishlashim **shart bo'lmaganida**, hayot ancha **oson bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **If** there **were** more buses, people **wouldn't use** their cars so much.
sentences.translation: Avtobuslar ko'proq **bo'lganida**, odamlar mashinalaridan buncha ko'p **foydalanmasdi**.

sentences.text: James **would come** with us **if** he **didn't have** an exam tomorrow.
The children **would be** happier **if** they **had** a garden to play in.
I **wouldn't feel** so tired **if** I **went** to bed earlier.

examples.title: Negative: **didn't** ..., **wouldn't** ...
examples.description: Inkor xayoliy shart: **if** + **didn't** / **wasn't**, natijada **wouldn't** («`-masdi`»). O'zbekchada — «`-maganida` / `-masa edi` ... `-masdi`».

sentences.text: Bekzod **wouldn't be** late every day **if** he **got up** earlier.
**If** you **didn't eat** so much sugar, your teeth **wouldn't hurt**.
We **wouldn't need** a taxi **if** the metro **were** open at night.
Sarah **wouldn't work** so hard **if** she **didn't love** her job.
**If** the flat **wasn't** so small, we**'d invite** more guests.
I **wouldn't drink** so much coffee **if** I **wasn't** so sleepy.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik **uyqum kelmasa edi**, buncha ko'p qahva **ichmasdim**.

sentences.text: My mum **would worry** less **if** I **phoned** her more often.
sentences.translation: Unga tez-tez **qo'ng'iroq qilganimda**, onam kamroq **xavotir olardi**.

sentences.text: **If** people **didn't drop** litter, the streets **would be** cleaner.
Tom **wouldn't understand** the film **if** it **didn't have** subtitles.
Our team **would win** more games **if** the players **trained** harder.
sentences.translation: O'yinchilar qattiqroq **mashq qilganida**, jamoamiz ko'proq **g'alaba qozonardi**.

examples.title: **If I were you**, I'd ...: giving advice
examples.description: **If I were you** — «o'rningda bo'lganimda / o'rningda bo'lsam» — yumshoq maslahat. Ko'pincha gap oxirida keladi: I'd ... **if I were you**.

sentences.text: **If I were you**, I**'d take** the job.
I **wouldn't buy** that car **if I were you** — it's too old.
sentences.translation: **O'rningda bo'lsam**, u mashinani **olmasdim** — u juda eski.

sentences.text: **If I were you**, I**'d see** a doctor about that cough.
I**'d apologise** to her **if I were you**.
Should I tell Aziz? — Yes, I**'d tell** him **if I were you**.
Honestly, I **wouldn't wait** any longer **if I were you**.
Take a jacket — I **would** **if I were you**. It's going to be cold.
sentences.translation: Kurtka olib ol — **o'rningda bo'lsam**, **olardim**. Havo soviydi.

sentences.text: My advice? I**'d book** the tickets online **if I were you**.
sentences.translation: Maslahatim: **o'rningda bo'lganimda**, chiptalarni internet orqali **band qilardim**.

sentences.text: I **wouldn't worry** about it **if I were you**. Everything will be fine.
sentences.translation: **O'rningda bo'lsam**, bu haqda **xavotir olmasdim**. Hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

sentences.text: What **would** you **do** **if** you **were** me?

examples.title: **were** with all persons: if it **were**, if she **were**
examples.description: Xayoliy shartda **be** — barcha shaxslar bilan **were**. So'zlashuvda I / he / she / it bilan **was** ham uchraydi (5-gap).

sentences.text: **If** it **were** warmer, we**'d have** lunch in the garden.
Bukhara **would be** perfect for a holiday **if** it **weren't** so hot in summer.
sentences.translation: Yozda bunchalik **issiq bo'lmaganida**, Buxoro dam olish uchun **ideal bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **If** my brother **were** here, he**'d fix** the computer in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Akam shu yerda **bo'lganida**, kompyuterni besh daqiqada **tuzatib qo'yardi**.

sentences.text: Emma **would be** a great teacher **if** she **were** more patient.
**If** the hotel **was** nearer the centre, it **would be** more popular.
I**'d go** out tonight **if** I **weren't** so tired.
You **wouldn't say** that **if** you **were** really my friend.
More students **would study** in London **if** it **were** cheaper.
sentences.translation: London arzonroq **bo'lganida**, u yerda ko'proq talaba **o'qirdi**.

sentences.text: Everything **would be** easier **if** we **were** all in the same city.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz bir shaharda **bo'lganimizda**, hamma narsa osonroq **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **be** happier **if** your job **were** closer to home?

examples.title: Real or unreal? **If I have** / **If I had**
examples.description: Juftliklar: real shart (**if** + Present, **will** — mumkin) va xayoliy shart (**if** + Past, **would** — haqiqatga zid). O'zbekchada: «bo'lsa ... `-aman`» ↔ «bo'lganida ... `-ardim`».

sentences.text: **If** I **have** time tomorrow, I**'ll help** you.
**If** I **had** more time, I**'d help** you, but I'm very busy.
sentences.translation: Vaqtim ko'proq **bo'lganida**, **yordam berardim**, lekin juda bandman.

sentences.text: We**'ll go** to the beach **if** it**'s** sunny tomorrow.
We**'d go** to the beach **if** it **wasn't** raining.
Madina **will buy** the dress **if** it**'s** in the sale.
Madina **would buy** the dress **if** she **had** enough money.
**If** Tom **calls**, I**'ll tell** him the news.
Tom **would know** all our news **if** he **called** more often.
Your English **will improve** **if** you **practise** every day.
Your English **would improve** faster **if** you **practised** every day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni **mashq qilganingizda**, ingliz tilingiz tezroq **yaxshilanardi**.

examples.title: Questions: What would you do **if** ...?
examples.description: Xayoliy savollar va javoblar: savolda ham, javobda ham **would** («`-arding`?» — «`-ardim`»). Qisqa javob: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.

sentences.text: What **would** you **do** **if** you **won** a million pounds? — I**'d buy** a house for my parents.
sentences.translation: Million funt **yutib olsang**, nima **qilarding**? — Ota-onamga uy **olib berardim**.

sentences.text: Where **would** you **live** **if** you **could** choose any city? — Probably in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Istalgan shaharni **tanlay olganingda**, qayerda **yasharding**? — Balki Samarqandda.

sentences.text: **Would** you **fly** to the moon **if** somebody **offered** you a ticket? — No way!
sentences.translation: Kimdir chipta **taklif qilsa**, Oyga **uchib borarmiding**? — Hech qachon!

sentences.text: Who **would** you **call** **if** you **were** in trouble? — My older brother.
What **would** your parents **say** **if** you **left** university? — They**'d be** very upset.
sentences.translation: Universitetni **tashlab ketsang**, ota-onang nima **derdi**? — Juda **xafa bo'lishardi**.

sentences.text: **If** you **could** speak any language, which one **would** you **choose**? — Japanese.
sentences.translation: Istalgan tilda **gapira olganingda**, qaysi birini **tanlarding**? — Yapon tilini.

sentences.text: **Would** you **be** angry **if** I **borrowed** your bike? — Of course not.
How **would** you **feel** **if** your best friend **moved** abroad? — I**'d miss** him a lot.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin do'sting chet elga **ko'chib ketsa**, o'zingni qanday **his qilarding**? — Uni juda **sog'inardim**.

sentences.text: **If** you **met** a famous actor, what **would** you **ask** him? — I don't know.
sentences.translation: Mashhur aktyor bilan **uchrashib qolsang**, undan nima **so'rarding**? — Bilmayman.

sentences.text: Which country **would** you **visit** **if** you **had** a free ticket? — Britain, of course.
sentences.translation: Bepul chipta **bo'lganida**, qaysi davlatga **borarding**? — Albatta, Britaniyaga.

examples.title: **could** and **might**: other results
examples.description: Natija qismida **could** («`-a olardim`») va **might** («balki ... `-ardim`») ham keladi. **if** li qism o'zgarmaydi — Past Simple.

sentences.text: **If** Aziz **had** a car, he **could drive** us to the airport.
sentences.translation: Azizning mashinasi **bo'lganida**, bizni aeroportga **olib bora olardi**.

sentences.text: We **could go** skiing **if** there **was** more snow.
**If** you **spoke** English, you **could get** a better job.
I **might buy** that jacket **if** it **was** a bit cheaper.
Emma **could visit** us more often **if** she **didn't live** so far away.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik uzoqda **yashamaganida**, Emma bizni tez-tez **ko'rgani kela olardi**.

sentences.text: My sister **could make** plov for you **if** she **knew** the recipe.
sentences.translation: Retseptini **bilganida**, singlim senga palov **pishirib bera olardi**.

sentences.text: The children **might sleep** better **if** their room **wasn't** so hot.
**If** we **lived** in London, we **could see** your cousins every weekend.
sentences.translation: Londonda **yashaganimizda**, amakivachchalaringni har dam olish kuni **ko'ra olardik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **might get** the job **if** he **had** more experience.
You **could ask** Sarah for help **if** she **wasn't** so busy these days.
sentences.translation: Bu kunlarda bunchalik **band bo'lmaganida**, Saradan yordam **so'rashing mumkin edi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: dreams and plans
examples.description: Ikki do'st xayol suradi: **What would you do if ...?**, **If I were ...**, **I'd ...** jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — What **would** you **do** **if** you **didn't have** to work?
— I**'d travel** around the world. What about you?
— I**'d stay** at home and read books all day.
sentences.translation: — Men uyda o'tirib, kun bo'yi kitob **o'qirdim**.

sentences.text: — Really? You**'d be** bored **if** you **stayed** at home every day.
— Maybe. But **if** I **had** a lot of money, I**'d buy** a farm.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Lekin pulim ko'p **bo'lganida**, ferma **sotib olardim**.

sentences.text: — A farm? You **wouldn't last** a week **if** you **lived** on a farm!
— That's not true. **If** I **were** a farmer, I**'d grow** apples.
— OK. And **if** you **could** live anywhere, where **would** you **go**?
— Somewhere near Samarkand. It **would be** wonderful **if** my family **were** near me.
sentences.translation: — Samarqand yaqinidagi biror joyga. Oilam yonimda **bo'lganida**, ajoyib **bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: — Then start saving now — **if I were you**, I**'d open** a bank account today!
sentences.translation: — Unda hozirdan pul yig'ishni boshla — **o'rningda bo'lganimda**, bugunoq bank hisobi **ochardim**!
